provenance.note: Annual-average CPI inflation (% y/y): 1980-1995 from IMF WEO DataMapper PCPIPCH (VNM); 1996-2025 from World Bank FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG (last updated 2026-10-08). Index built backwards with base 2025=100: index[y]=index[y+1]/(1+infl[y+1]/100); rounded to 6 significant digits. 1980 inflation value (IMF 25.2%) is not needed for the index. All 46 years derived directly from sourced inflation rates; no interpolation. Note IMF 1986-1988 shows hyperinflation (453.5%, 360.4%, 374.4%).

Pre-1989 values are the official rate, which diverged strongly from the parallel market until the 1989 unification. 2025: ESTIMATED (World Bank has no 2025 value yet) = WB 2024 (24164.89) x SimianX market annual-average ratio 2025/2024 (26022/25071, CBC Taipei daily interbank quotes); chained to keep basis continuity with WB series. Replace when WB publishes 2025.

provenance.note: VND per luong (37.5 g). MIXED BASIS: (a) 1986-1999 PROXY, annual-average basis = World Bank Pink Sheet gold annual average USD/troy oz (London PM fix average) x 37.5/31.1035 x fxPerUsd[y] (WB official annual average); 14 years. Cross-check: 1995 proxy 5,110,383 vs SimianX year-end proxy 5,139,464. 1986-1988 use the pre-unification official FX and badly understate the real street price. (b) 2000-2008 RANGE-DERIVED = midpoint of Finhay's yearly SJC min-max range (million VND/luong); 9 years; neither year-end nor true average. (c) 2009-2024 SJC sell price at 31 Dec from giavang.org daily history pages (HCMC); 16 years, year-end. (d) 2025 SJC sell price at close of 31/12/2025 = 152.8 million (giavang.org page empty; Dan Tri, Bao Quoc Te, Tinnhanhchungkhoan all report 150.8-152.8 mua-ban). 1980-1985 omitted (no VND/USD rate available). No interpolated years.

closes[y]/closes[y-1]-1 for 1987-2025. Basis breaks: 2000 return (proxy average -> Finhay midpoint) and 2009 return (Finhay midpoint -> SJC year-end) mix bases and are approximate. 1987-1989 dominated by official FX devaluation/hyperinflation. 2025 = +79.1% (SJC year-end to year-end).
